    public $tag;

    public static function capture($saved, $ignored) { echo 'STATIC:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { $prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $GLOBALS['late'] = $prefix . 'END'; echo 'THIS-END:', $this->tag, ';'; }
}

}

    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { $GLOBALS['kept'] = $arguments['later']; echo 'MAGIC;'; return false; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; }
}
$prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $kept = null;
$owner = new PeerMagic245; $runner = new PeerChild245(8);
$result = $runner->run(); echo 'RETURN;'; echo 'LATE:', $late, ';'; echo 'VALUE:', $kept, ';'; unset($kept); unset($late); echo 'AFTER;';
